newsitem.title: USA: Plasma & Materials breakthrough boosts stock.
newsitem.headline: Plasma & Materials breakthrough boosts stock.

text.p: Plasma & Materials Technologies Inc. said Monday it has made a technological breakthrough that could boost the speed of semiconductor devices, triggering a sharp rise in its stock.
The discovery would result in lower equipment costs, manufacturing time, and defect levels, it said.
The stock of the Chatsworth, Calif.-based company rose $3.875 or more than 32 percent to $15.75 on Nasdaq at midday.
Plasma & Materials, a supplier of equipment used to make semiconductors, said it will present its findings at an industry conference in San Jose, Calif. later Monday.
The company said the development was made at its recently acquired Electrotech unit.
